name: Battlefield 6
native_kbm_note: DICE confirmed keyboard and mouse support for the console versions, PS5 included (mp1st.com/news/battlefield-6-keyboard-target-framerates-on-all-consoles-and-crossplay-explained; consolepcgaming.com/dice-confirms-mouse-and-keyboard-support-for-battlefield-6-on-consoles).
notes: Infantry bindings only; vehicles use different PS5 buttons (e.g. exit vehicle is Square; E on PC). Crouch on PS5 is a Circle toggle and prone is a Circle hold. PC hold-crouch (LCTRL) and toggle (C) both map to Circle. Weapon slots 1/2 map to Triangle, which cycles primary/secondary; armor plate (5) is a Triangle hold. Sources conflict on melee: Prima lists L3, Destructoid lists R3; R3 is used here because L3 is sprint. Fire mode/zeroing (B) and laser/flashlight (T) are on the D-pad: Prima says D-pad Down, Destructoid says Right; Prima's Down is used. Night vision (7) is a D-pad Up hold, the same button as class gadget (X). On PS5, Touchpad opens the big map, Touchpad hold opens inventory and Options hold opens the scoreboard. Steady scope = Shift while aiming (L3 while aiming). Vehicle seats F1-F6 omitted.
